facts.fact: Djibouti's Ministry of Digital Economy and Innovation launched a digital-skills programme for government officials with DCO, Oracle University and INAP, covering cloud, AI, cybersecurity and data management through Oracle MyLearn.
facts.system: Oracle University MyLearn programme for government officials

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Economy and Innovation

DJI.note: The programme is for government officials only; the document states no programme for the public.
